test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 07 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'GHOST’ is written as 'VVSMM' and 'EATER' is written as 'THXFK'. How will 'HANDS' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e82b7da6e41b2a069e2db44b7b686c69a4d8afae6d389dc05a659aaeaa56953.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

'GHOST’ is written as 'VVSMM' 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/002bc74f1eeec3b13ea262e6ed2862bd3384efdd7485e7797ca86a85b987f542.png] 

And, 'EATER' is written as 'THXFK'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/443de12e6d37d34225c13860443247ecb8067aad0ec8dac24fabc654db906138.png] 

Similarly, for 'HANDS'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dcbab4766be28b330b66d59895c1af8cf1c0e2b80dcee561b05b1da3f72bf7e4.png] 

'HANDS' is written as 'UGRFN'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
